interactives.label: Rules of the wash
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead wake at the east gate. Waystones count you out. The court is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The wash
interactives.text: When the rains come the wash runs a horse deep for an hour. The rest of the year it is the only shade for a day's ride, and everything knows it.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Red Canyon
gauntlet.flavour: A dry wash that cuts through the red rock east of the camp. The herds shelter in it and the things that eat the herds follow them in.
